==Active policy proposals==
Feel free to make changes and comment directly on these pages, or use the respective "discussion" link in their headers for more general concerns.
* [[Help:Style guide|Style guidelines]] for capitalization, linkification, article names, etc.
* Work on [[project:chapter summaries]] is ongoing; we have about 8 so far for ''[[The Eye of the World]]''; of particular interest is the reasonably complete [[Template:summary]] draft ([[User:Gherald/test cases|example use]])
* The heavy lifting for a [[project:Category index|category index]] is mostly complete for now, and can gradually be added to.

==Technical Matters==
* [[Special:Allmessages]] contains certain defaults from Wikia that are uglier than the ones on Wikipedia; also, we may want to convert some of these to 'thematic' messages (such as the [[project:Sidebar|sidebar]] on the left).
* [[project:cascading style sheets|CSS stuff]].
